title: Spatial Heterogeneity in Climate Risk and Human Flourishing: An Exploration with Generative AI
reasoning: The paper uses a fine-tuned LLM to extract and evaluate dimensions of human flourishing that specifically include religious and moral components such as 'religiosity,' 'belief in God,' 'spiritual life,' 'character and virtue,' 'forgiveness,' and 'gratitude' from a massive dataset of geotagged tweets.
